paragraph: - **Anti-cheat:** for Steam, planned: a server checks each run before posting it to trusted boards, which waits on the game's own Steam App ID. It shipped with version 0.9.1; older versions can no longer post scores. A run only counts once it ends (a game over, the last level cleared, a Survival win), and since 2026-10-28 quitting a run that would be dropped says so: THIS RUN WON'T COUNT ON THE LEADERBOARDS.

quote: Every character is a chubby man in white briefs who floats like a balloon and flies by farting.
paragraph: **The game, for every agent.** Bottom Busters is a comedy arcade game. Every character is a chubby man in white briefs who floats like a balloon and flies by farting. A character's health is two cheeks, and lives are white underwear icons. The humor is gross-out and physical. Poo piles up and dirties bodies, cheeks and hats, and the base coat never washes off. Other humor-first visuals include cheek "health" and the chef animals in the bonus rounds. Everything new has to read at game size and sit beside what's already in the game. Nothing is copied from real people, brands, logos, or characters from other games or shows.
